invariants.rationale: The method always returns a HoodieWriteMetadata object as per implementation.
HoodieWriteMetadata#getWriteStatuses() should return a non-null list corresponding to write status.
Since this is an insert operation, the operation type in the metadata should be INSERT if available.
instantTime is used to identify the commit action and should not be null or empty at exit.
Insert is generally expected to be called with non-empty records; an empty write might be treated as a no-op.
